selection.description: Photo of Lou Ferrigno as The Incredible Hulk from the television special that preceded the regular television series.
selection.author: CBS Television
selection.license: Public domain in the United States; published in 1977 without a copyright notice.

rejected_alternative.description: Bill Bixby as David Banner and Lou Ferrigno as the Hulk.
rejected_alternative.ruling: Valid exact identity and transformation context, but rejected for the card because Bill Bixby occupies half the frame and the Hulk is not the sole dominant subject.

crop.semantics: Custom vertical crop after cover-resizing. It preserves the hair silhouette, both eyes, brow makeup, nose, mouth, jaw, upper chest, and publicity-costume context better than the stock north, center, or south gravities.

notes: The selected 7 October 1977 CBS Television publicity photograph visibly depicts Lou Ferrigno as the television Hulk.
Universal Pictures At Home independently identifies Lou Ferrigno as the transformed Hulk in the complete-series synopsis and cast list.
The exact Commons file page retains the CBS authorship, publication date, description, and US public-domain determination.
The solo image is preferred over the valid Banner/Hulk two-shot because the transformed character is the sole dominant subject.
A custom y=350 crop after cover-resizing preserves the full transformed face and upper-body context better than stock gravity choices.
The candidate is not Bill Bixby alone, a later Hulk performer, comics, animation, merchandise, or a generic bodybuilder.
Exact-byte duplicate screening must pass against 2,070 canonical repository hashes.
